input: Build a LAMMPS data file in the class I CVFF-INTERFACE force field (INTERFACE FF 1.5) for an HPEG-type PCE lying flat 3 Å above the hydroxylated (040) surface of tricalcium silicate (the INTERFACE FF model, 2x2 slab cells laterally): 4 methallyl-ether PEG side chains of 10 ethylene-oxide units (OH-terminated) and 8 acrylic acid units (all deprotonated), random sequence, sodium counter-ions.
note: normal along y: lateral cells along x and z
